spellbook.finance/limitations: A floor is a minimum sell price and does not mean the current ask equals the floor.
An exact-price lock is shared across all marketplaces. This read does not restore a price or trigger repricing.
A protected lock can only be changed or removed by the workspace owner outside delegated access. An already submitted marketplace update may still complete.
Workspace ownership, seller entitlement and feature flags remain backend-enforced.

description: Read one seller SKU's exact minimum floor and exact-price lock by printing, finish and condition. Returns saved values, timestamps, all-marketplaces lock scope and whether the seller protected the lock from agent changes. Call it before changing a floor or lock, then read it again after a write.

condition.description: The exact physical condition for the SKU. Required.

finish.description: The exact finish for the SKU: nf, fo, etched, surge, rh, 1e or 1e-fo. Required.

scryfallId.description: The exact Scryfall printing id. Required.

workspaceId.description: The workspace the seller selected. The caller must own it. Required.
